title: I Spent $1100 on DisplayPort Cables… for Science!
summary: Linus Tech Tips tests a large batch of DisplayPort cables with a Total Phase cable tester, checking bandwidth and signal quality. Many cables did not meet their claimed specs.
why: HN cites it as evidence that DisplayPort cable labeling is unreliable and that even major brands can fail, and for its explanation of version differences.

quote.text: Good and interesting video to explain the version diffs in spec
